title.zh: 签名留证：perworld L v2 灯 S-2 采集窗获用户双签（计划 + baseline 13,302 / signed floor 10,230 + authoring 例外 + 失败条款；零 GPU）
title.en: Signature record: per-world L v2 light S-2 capture window dual-signed by the user (plan + baseline 13,302 / signed floor 10,230 + authoring exception + failure clauses; GPU-free)

intent.zh: 用户 2026-11-08 通过聊天卡选项「双签 S-2（计划 + floor 10,230）」签署 S-2。本卡只做**签名留证**：① S-2 receipt `status` 转 `signed_pending_window`、`signed_object=true`，新增 `signature` 块（signer=user / signed_at=2026-11-08 / Asia/Shanghai / method=聊天卡选择 / scope=S-2a 计划 + S-2b（baseline_free 13,302 / signed floor 10,230 / floor_effective=max(signed,现场)）+ authoring 例外 + 失败条款）并写死 material_sha256=c8bb71ef…/18,299 B；② 加 `signature_status`（S-1 signed / S-2 signed 2026-11-08 / S-3 not signed）并同步 S-1 receipt 的 `signature_status` 与 `signatures_required`（additive）；③ README 加「用户 S-2 签名 2026-11-08」版本记录；④ 两处 manifest 重算。**spec.md 字节零改动**：提交前后各算一次 sha256，必须仍为 bb064fe0… / 39,379 B。签名不构成开窗（仍需 QA PASS + Chief token + 现场 floor 取更严 + monitor 60/60）。零 GPU、不改 src/tests/fixtures/scripts。
intent.en: The user dual-signed S-2 on 2026-11-08 via chat card (plan + floor 10,230). This card only records the signature: S-2 receipt status to signed_pending_window, signed_object true, new signature block (signer user, signed_at 2026-11-08 Asia/Shanghai, method chat card, scope S-2a plan + S-2b baseline 13,302 / signed floor 10,230 / floor_effective=max(signed,onspot) + authoring exception + failure clauses) with material_sha256 c8bb71ef.../18,299 B; add signature_status S-1 signed / S-2 signed 2026-11-08 / S-3 not signed and synchronise the S-1 receipt signature_status and signatures_required additively; add the README version record; recompute both manifests. spec.md bytes must not change: sha256 before and after must still be bb064fe0... / 39,379 B. Signing does not open the window (still needs QA PASS + Chief token + on-the-spot stricter floor + monitor 60/60). GPU-free; src/tests/fixtures/scripts unchanged.

acceptance: **卡与范围**：卡 id `2026-11-08-render-perworld-l-v2-capture-window-s2-signature`，owner Arch，p70，depends_on = S-2 材料卡 + S-1 签名卡；写入范围仅 `docs/development-evidence/render-bvh/perworld-l-v2-capture-window-s2/` 的 receipt/README/manifest + `docs/development-evidence/render-bvh/perworld-l-v2-light-criterion/receipt.json` 的 `signature_status`/`signatures_required` 与其 manifest + 本卡与 runs；**spec.md 不碰**。
**spec.md 冻结自核**：提交前后各算一次 `spec.md` sha256/bytes，必须逐位等于 `bb064fe0a85ab38abba8043768666a0d9f73fc53d9f2f3dd72eace060c8a924d` / 39,379 B；前后值写入 S-2 receipt `signature.material` 邻近字段或 README 版本记录。

**S-2 receipt 签名块**：`status=material_fixed_r2_pending_qa_recheck_and_user_dual_sign` → `signed_pending_window`；`signed_object` false → true（含 boundary 内同名键）；新增 `signature`：signer=user、signed_at=2026-11-08、timezone=Asia/Shanghai、method=聊天卡选择、scope=S-2a 计划 + S-2b（baseline_free 13,302 / signed floor 10,230 / floor_effective=max(signed, 现场)）+ authoring 例外（2026-11-08 预批，仅本采集窗）+ 失败条款、material_sha256=`c8bb71ef…`/18,299 B、`does_not_open_window` 写明仍需 QA PASS + Chief token + 现场 floor 取更严 + monitor 60/60。

**signature_status 同步**：S-2 receipt 新增 `signature_status`（S-1 signed / S-2 signed 2026-11-08 / S-3 not yet signed）；S-1 receipt `signature_status.S-2` 改 signed 2026-11-08、`signatures_required` 的 S-2 行改 SIGNED（additive，不动 S-1/S-3 事实）。
**README 版本记录**：加「用户 S-2 签名 2026-11-08」条目（签名对象 README sha `c8bb71ef…`/18,299 B、scope、签名不构成开窗、留证卡 id），并更新顶部状态行。
**manifest 与门禁**：S-2 与 S-1 两处 manifest 重算并各自自核；四门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit；`unchanged src/, tests/, fixtures/, scripts/`；零 GPU、不采集、不改任何判据/阈值/相机/recipe。
**非声明**：不宣称采集有效 / per-world 灯验收 / 上游等价 / 任何渲染数值结论；签名不等于开窗、不等于 G-L1 结果。
note: Chief 2026-11-08 派工：用户已双签 S-2（计划 + floor 10,230），做签名留证卡。范围：S-2 证据（receipt/README/manifest）+ S-1 receipt 的 signature_status/signatures_required（additive）+ 本卡证据。spec.md 字节零改动（前后 sha 留证）。签名不构成开窗：G-L1 仍需 QA PASS + Chief token + 现场 floor 取更严 + monitor 60/60；做完停手等 Chief 开窗。 另：S-1 receipt 改动后必须重算其 manifest（否则清单与 receipt 不一致），故写范围含该 manifest。

checks.equals: signed 2026-11-08 (dual sign: plan + baseline 13,302 MiB / signed floor 10,230 MiB); signing does NOT open G-L1 (needs QA PASS + Chief token + on-the-spot stricter floor + monitor 60/60)
